items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I was the only one writing at the time till Earl Thompson came in

ctx.x: Up until then, before you sat down and wrote 20 things...right off the bat like that, about how much had you written for the band? Had you been writing for quite some time?

Yes, I guess I had given them almost a complete book because I was the only one writing at the time till Earl Thompson came in and then later on we picked up on other people, you know, on the outside. But I was doing most of the arranging, Andy and I.
Now was this part of the period when you were playing mostly in Kansas City, you had a chance to live there? I mean, you were part of the musical life in Kansas City?
